tools.name: publish_doc
tools.description: Publish Markdown as a beautifully typeset page and receive its https://lucid.page/<slug> URL. Works anonymously; with an lp_ API key the page is owned by the account and can be updated later. Anonymous publishes return a one-time claim_token — hand your human the claim link https://lucid.page/claim?

tools.name: update_doc
tools.description: Replace the Markdown of a page you own (requires an lp_ API key). The URL stays the same; every update is kept as a revision. Pass expected_version (from get_doc) to guard against overwriting someone else's changes — a conflict returns 409 with current_version.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Fetch the canonical Markdown source of a page. Public and unlisted pages are open to anyone; private pages require the owner's lp_ API key.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List the documents owned by the authenticated account (requires an lp_ API key), newest first, with cursor pagination.

tools.name: delete_doc
tools.description: Permanently delete a page you own (requires an lp_ API key). The URL stops serving immediately and cannot be recovered.

tools.name: create_binder
tools.description: Create a binder: an ordered list of lucid.page pages and external links, each with an optional note, served at https://lucid.page/b/<slug> (requires an lp_ API key). Up to 100 binders per account and 500 items per binder. Public binders with at least one visible item are indexable.

tools.name: add_to_binder
tools.description: Append one item to a binder you own (requires an lp_ API key). Pass exactly one of slug (a lucid.page page) or url (any http(s) link), plus an optional title (links only) and note.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Show the lucid.page account matrix (anonymous vs lp_ API key) and, when a key is present, the caller's current plan status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_doc · Private data: publish_doc, update_doc, get_doc, list_docs, delete_doc, create_binder, add_to_binder, get_limits · Public sink: publish_doc · Destructive: delete_doc.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_doc · Private data: publish_doc, update_doc, get_doc, list_docs, delete_doc, create_binder, add_to_binder, get_limits · Public sink: publish_doc · Destructive: delete_doc

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "update_doc" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Replace the Markdown of a page you own (requires an lp_ API key). The URL stays the same; every update is kept as a revision." → after: "Replace the Markdown of a page you own (requires an lp_ API key). The URL stays the same; every update is kept as a revision. Pass expected_version (from get_doc) to guard against overwriting someone else's changes — a conflict returns 409 with current_version."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
